summary: Completed frontend-only e2e testing of LaundryMax POS screen on mobile viewport (420x900). All 14 required flows verified: app load, header, customer dropdown with member 10% discount, 4 tabs navigation (Kiloan/Satuan/Sepatu/Showcase), kiloan +/- 0.5kg (min 0, Rp 6.000/kg), satuan/sepatu/showcase counters at correct prices, dynamic total price, photo upload mock with FOTO TERSIMPAN state, save button disabled/enabled gating, QR dialog with order ID LM-* and qrcode canvas, Order Baru full reset. No console errors captured.

issues: Typo in Indonesian copy: 'AMBIL FOTO CUCIAAN' has extra 'A' — should likely be 'CUCIAN'. Minor copy issue, not blocking.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Fix typo 'AMBIL FOTO CUCIAAN' -> 'AMBIL FOTO CUCIAN' in POSScreen.jsx photo-upload-button label.
critical_code_review_comments: POSScreen.jsx is ~585 lines — acceptable but approaching the point where splitting sub-components (CustomerSelect, TabsSection, PhotoCaptureDialog, QRDialog) into separate files would aid maintainability.
orderId generation uses Date/Math.random client-side; fine for frontend-only mock but document that this must be replaced with server-issued ID when backend is added.
Photo upload uses a setTimeout mock (900ms) — clearly MOCKED. Confirmed per problem statement.
QR payload uses JSON.stringify with local timestamp — fine for mock; no PII leakage.
